newsitem.title: USA: CME feeder cattle up near limit to new highs.
newsitem.headline: CME feeder cattle up near limit to new highs.

text.p: CME feeder cattle ran up for a near limit gain of 1.400 cents per lb in May and all months posted new contract highs on demand prompted by expected higher cash feeder markets next week, traders said.
May rose to a new high of 75.350 cents and August posted a new high of 77.500, up 1.075 cents.

Fund buying and buy stops added to the gain that developed on anticipation of stronger cash feeder markets next week. Active fed cattle movement should encourage increased interest for heavier-weight replacement type feeders, they said.
